regions.name: Presenter expression, gesture and firing-side silhouette
regions.finding: Open mouth, lifted hands, bent knees and auburn/coral/slate identity communicate the startled beat. The entire presenter remains visibly left of the left-facing cannon mouth. Some fine edges are soft, but identity and action are clear at 4x. Preserve the prior 73-pixel left translation and existing scale.

regions.name: Cannon barrel, cradle, pedestal mount and direction
regions.finding: The tilted barrel faces left/up; its collar, angled support and base remain connected and grounded on the platform. No floating part or reversed firing-side relationship is demonstrated. The comic confetti cannon does not require new mechanical detail.

regions.name: Confetti and overlapping effects
regions.finding: Sparse cream/coral confetti crosses the stage and a few costume edges. It supports the early-firing event without hiding the mouth, raised hands, cannon mount or controls. A small patch near the hem can read as confetti or a highlight; that does not justify erasing it.

regions.name: Green BEGIN and covered red release on the control pedestal
regions.finding: The left green activation lens/glyph and distinct right red release under its raised cream cover remain readable, with the pedestal support visible. The green lens is brighter in Surprise by the approved state design. Do not replace glyphs with tiny text or flatten the head.

regions.name: Corrected right-wall pictogram, buttons and PA grille
regions.finding: The fixture edges follow the approved side-wall interpretation rather than the older uniform upward tilt. The separate pictogram, vertical button group and lower grille remain legible. No new perspective defect is demonstrated.

regions.name: Large camera, rolling equipment and microphone
regions.finding: The foreground camera and stand are grounded and clearly separate from the platform. The microphone is retained in its approved Surprise state; Locomotion intentionally differs. No obstruction of the cannon firing-side pose is established.

regions.name: Raised platform, foot contacts and floor perspective
regions.finding: The presenter and cannon have visible contacts on the raised platform. Its elevation fits the preceding unauthorized-presenter beat. The outer stage, floor joints, chair scale and pedestal support remain coherent; no geometric correction is justified.
